verdicts.note: Walking in the park, I met an old friend. 主語Iの能動の現在分詞構文。
Feeling tired, she went to bed early. 能動現在分詞。
Opening the door, he went out. 能動現在分詞。
She sat on the sofa, reading a book. 付帯状況の分詞構文(文末)。
Hearing the news, she became very happy. 能動現在分詞。
Not knowing what to say, he kept silent. 否定はnotを分詞の前に置く。Knowing not/Don't knowingは不可。
Praised by everyone, he felt very happy. 受動(Being省略)の分詞構文。
Seen from a distance, the rock looks like a face. 受動の分詞構文。
Having finished the work, she went home. 主節より前に完了した動作=完了分詞構文。Finishingでも通るが選択肢の中ではHaving finishedが規範解。
Not being tired, I will go out with you. 否定notは分詞の前。Being notは語順誤り。
It being sunny, we decided... 主語Itが残る独立分詞構文(絶対分詞構文)。is/be/wasは従属節に定動詞が要り不可。
Being ill, he could not attend the meeting. 補語形容詞を伴う分詞構文。
Generally speaking, ... 慣用的独立分詞構文だが空所は副詞Generally対形容詞General等の品詞識別を問うており、分詞自体(speaking)は固定。分詞構文の核心(分詞形/否定/態)を直接問うていない=off_unit。正答はGenerally。
Having written the letter, she put it into her bag. 完了分詞構文(かばんに入れる前に書き終えた)。

verdicts.produced_sentence: I found the shop walking down the street.
verdicts.note: 意図はWalking down the street, I found the shop.だが、tokenのwalkingが小文字でコンマ付きtokenも無いため文頭分詞にできない。文頭に置けるのは大文字のIのみ。よって分詞句を文末に回した語順が唯一成立(分詞はIに掛かる)。意味は通るが文頭分詞構文の理想形は作れず(tokenのケース/コンマ欠如の制約)。

verdicts.produced_sentence: Not saying anything, he left the room.
verdicts.note: 否定の現在分詞構文。コンマ付き文頭句 'Not saying anything,' があり自然に文頭に置ける。

verdicts.produced_sentence: I watched TV having finished my homework.
verdicts.note: 意図はHaving finished my homework, I watched TV.だが havingが小文字でコンマ付きtokenも無く、文頭に置けるのは大文字のIのみ。よって完了分詞句を文末に回す語順が唯一。意味は通る(tokenのケース/コンマ欠如の制約)。
付帯状況の現在分詞構文。コンマ付き文頭句 'Smiling,' があり自然。

verdicts.produced_sentence: This book is easy to read written in English.
verdicts.note: 意図はWritten in English, this book is easy to read.だが、6tokenに大文字始まりが一つも無く(written/this book等すべて小文字)コンマ付きtokenも無いため、文頭を大文字にした文法的に正しい文を作れない=データ不備。最も自然な語順を示したが文頭大文字化不能のためgrammatical_issue=true。

verdicts.produced_sentence: Seeing the dog, I ran away.
verdicts.note: When I saw → Seeing(能動現在分詞)。主語Iは主節と一致し省略。

verdicts.produced_sentence: Being tired, she took a rest.
verdicts.note: Because she was → Being(指示通りBeingを省略しない形)。

verdicts.produced_sentence: When he saw the police officer, he ran away.
verdicts.note: 分詞構文Seeing→接続詞Whenの節 'When he saw' に復元。時制は主節に合わせ過去。

verdicts.produced_sentence: Having eaten lunch, I went out.
verdicts.note: After I had eaten → 完了分詞構文 Having eaten。

verdicts.produced_sentence: Not knowing the answer, he stayed silent.
verdicts.note: As he did not know → Not knowing(否定の現在分詞構文)。

verdicts.produced_sentence: Being written in easy English, the book sold well.
verdicts.note: Because it was written → 受動の分詞構文(指示通りBeingを省略しない Being written)。
